Strategy: Refine Best Fit with an item-size gate: when the item is small compared with the loosest bin, spread it into the loosest bin instead of the tightest, preserving tight bins; when the item is large, fall back to Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit only for small items with a looser bin available. Preserving tight bins may help items that fit few bins, but worst-fitting items can fragment bins and waste space.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    if item * 3 <= max(bins):
        return [r for r in bins]
    return [-(r - item) for r in bins]
```
